summary: NuRAN Wireless Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 21, 2026, incorporating by reference an Amended and Restated Annual Information Form dated June 4, 2026. The AIF replaces and supersedes the prior AIF to correct certain disclosure inaccuracies. No transaction, price, stake, premium, or advisor is stated; no board recommendation or deal mechanics are present. Key facts cover the year ended December 31, 2025. This is a routine corporate disclosure update equivalent to a US proxy/financial statement supplement, with no special-situation or risk-arb angle to watch.
